basic.name: Shard Sword
basic.description_template: Deals Wind DMG equal to {{scaling1}}% of Blade's Max HP to one designated enemy.

variants.name: Forest of Swords
variants.description_template: Consumes HP equal to 10% of Blade's Max HP and deals Wind DMG equal to {{scaling1}}% of his Max HP to one designated enemy. In addition, deals Wind DMG equal to {{scaling2}}% of Blade's Max HP to adjacent targets. If Blade's current HP is insufficient, his HP will be reduced to 1 when using "Forest of Swords." "Forest of Swords" cannot regenerate Skill Points.

skill.name: Hellscape
skill.description_template: Consumes HP equal to 30% of Blade's Max HP to enter the "Hellscape" state. While under the "Hellscape" state, his Skill cannot be used, his DMG dealt increases by {{scaling1}}%, the chance of receiving attacks from enemy targets greatly increases, and his Basic ATK "Shard Sword" is enhanced to "Forest of Swords" for 3 turn(s). If Blade's current HP is insufficient, his HP will be reduced to 1 when he uses his Skill. This Skill does not regenerate Energy. Using this Skill does not end the current turn.

ultimate.name: Death Sentence
ultimate.description_template: Sets Blade's current HP to 50% of his Max HP and deals Wind DMG to one designated enemy equal to the sum of {{scaling1}}% of his Max HP and {{scaling2}}% of the tally of Blade's HP loss in the current battle. At the same time, deals Wind DMG to adjacent targets equal to the sum of {{scaling3}}% of his Max HP and {{scaling3}}% of the tally of his HP loss in the current battle. The tally of Blade's HP loss in the current battle is capped at 90% of his Max HP. This value will be reset and re-accumulated after his Ultimate has been used.

talent.name: Shuhu's Gift
talent.description_template: When Blade sustains DMG or consumes his HP, he gains 1 stack of Charge, stacking up to 5 times. A max of 1 Charge stack can be gained every time he is attacked. When Charge stack reaches maximum, immediately launches 1 Follow-Up ATK  on all enemies, dealing Wind DMG equal to {{scaling1}}% of Blade's Max HP. At the same time, restores Blade's HP by 25% of his Max HP. After the Follow-Up ATK, all Charges are consumed.

technique.name: Karma Wind
technique.description: Immediately attacks the enemy. After entering combat, consumes 20% of Blade's Max HP while dealing Wind DMG equal to 40% of his Max HP to all enemies. If Blade's current HP is insufficient, his HP will be reduced to 1 when this Technique is used.

6.name: Cyclone of Destruction
6.description: Increases DMG dealt by the Talent's Follow-Up ATK  by 20%. Additionally regenerates 15 Energy.

4.name: Neverending Deaths
4.description: HP restored from healing increases by 20%. After receiving healing, 25% of the healed amount will be converted to Ultimate's tally of HP lost.

2.name: Vita Infinita
2.description: When Blade uses Ultimate, the total accumulated HP loss will be set to 50%.

eidolons.name: Blade Cuts the Deepest in Hell
eidolons.description: Blade's Enhanced Basic ATK and Ultimate deals additionally increased DMG to one designated enemy, with the increased amount equal to 150% of the tally of Blade's HP loss from his Ultimate.

eidolons.name: Ten Thousand Sorrows From One Broken Dream
eidolons.description: When Blade is in the Hellscape state, his CRIT Rate increases by 15%.

eidolons.name: Hardened Blade Bleeds Coldest Shade
eidolons.description: Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15. Talent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.

eidolons.name: Rejected by Death, Infected With Life
eidolons.description: When Blade's current HP percentage drops from above 50% to 50% or lower of his Max HP, increases his Max HP by 20%. Stacks up to 2 time(s).

eidolons.name: Death By Ten Lords' Gaze
eidolons.description: Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15. Basic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. 10.

eidolons.name: Reborn Into an Empty Husk
eidolons.description: The maximum number of Charge stacks is reduced to 4. The Follow-up ATK triggered by Talent deals additionally increased DMG equal to 50% of Blade's Max HP.
